हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: “Wifey on Day One” is a high-stakes romantic drama with a sci-fi twist, where Yash Malhotra, a food delivery rider, wakes up in a surreal “system game” that casts him as the villain in a love story. Struggling to survive against the true hero Dev Trivedi, navigate tangled relationships with heroines Yuvika and Siya, and outsmart power-hungry tycoons like Bhairav and Mr. Mehra, Yash must balance love, betrayal, and corporate wars while rewriting his own destiny
